items.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.summary: OpenAI explores perplexity as a metric for evaluating AI model progress, offering developers a potential shared approach to assessing emerging capabilities.

items.title: Long-Range Video Presentation Attack Detection
items.summary: A new benchmark for video-based PAD systems across multiple distances and sensor types, improving real-world readiness for face recognition systems.

items.title: Auditing Learned Dynamics in Weather Models
items.summary: Research explores whether AI weather models rely on physical semantics for reliable forecasts, with implications for high-assurance systems.

items.title: Temporal Extrapolation of Seismic Wave Propagation

items.title: Watch Where You Linearize
items.summary: New method predicts model-merging interference using directional derivatives for efficient coefficient search.

items.title: Density Feedback Control
items.summary: DFC improves transferability of adversarial attacks by dynamically adjusting sparsity coefficients.

items.title: A Model of Diverse Sampling
items.summary: PoolDPP enables diverse generation by sampling from a determinantal point process with importance weighting.

items.title: On the Impact of Feature Reduction
items.summary: Feature reduction techniques affect adversarial robustness, with implications for attack strategies and defenses.

items.title: Ollama v0.40.17
items.summary: Ollama released inkling-2-mini, a 26B parameter model with 5.4B active parameters, supporting Apple silicon only. It handles text, images, and tool calls, scoring 79.2% on SWE-Bench.

items.title: PsyWorld: Profile-Conditioned World Modeling
items.summary: A new method for human behavior prediction using profile-conditioned state world models that leverage observed environment-behavior transitions for better behavioral prediction.

items.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.summary: OpenAI introduced a layered approach to protect against capability extraction through adversarial distillation, combining model training, detection, and enforcement.

items.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary: Hugging Face announced Inkling 2 Mini, a cutting-edge model for local setups with improved performance and efficiency.

items.title: MedChemBench for Drug Discovery
items.summary: OpenAI introduces MedChemBench, a benchmark evaluating AI models' ability to interpret molecular structures and select compounds in early drug discovery. This improves the practical application of AI in pharmaceutical research.

items.title: HireWatch: Legal Compliance in Hiring LLMs
items.summary: HireWatch evaluates LLMs for compliance with U.S. employment laws by using a 200-question legal bank, ensuring legal safety in hiring processes.

items.title: PRKV: Efficient KV Cache Eviction
items.summary: PRKV introduces a training-free method for efficient KV cache eviction in long-context LLMs, improving memory usage and inference performance.

items.title: DSFlow: Neuro-Symbolic Data Agent
items.summary: DSFlow combines LLM skills with deterministic guardrails for data workflows, enabling reliable and reproducible data science pipelines.

items.title: LLM Complexity
items.summary: A paper explores computational complexity in LLM inference, challenging the analogy between token length and classical time complexity. This could reshape how efficiency is measured and optimized in LLM systems.

items.title: FinVeriQA
items.summary: FinVeriQA introduces a multi-agent framework for financial QA, integrating routing, retrieval, and evidence verification. It addresses key challenges in financial LLM accuracy and reliability.

items.title: CANDID
items.summary: CANDID is an execution-control framework for local computer-use agents, enhancing reliability in resource-constrained settings by managing action loops and premature termination.

items.title: HapBO
items.summary: HapBO introduces a Bayesian optimization method using natural language priors, improving sample efficiency by leveraging expert knowledge in a more flexible and interpretable way.

items.title: Prioritize, Don't Decide: CV Sorter Audit
items.summary: A deployed CV Priority Sorter for academic vacancies is audited, using a multilingual encoder and session-specific models to guide human reviewers.

items.title: Human-AI Mutualism Instability
items.summary: A paper argues that human-AI mutualism is unstable under capability asymmetry, with models potentially harming human interests through bargaining.

items.title: Deploying Daybreak Red
items.summary: OpenAI explores a reference architecture for supervised security investigations using Daybreak Red, including safety controls and monitoring setups.

items.title: GPT-Live 1.1 on AI Gateway
items.summary: GPT-Live 1.1 now available on AI Gateway. It improves speech transcription accuracy and maintains consistent accent across languages.

items.title: Gemini API Tool Retrieval
items.summary: Gemini API now supports Tool Retrieval, allowing agents to use hundreds of tools with fewer tokens.

items.title: Performance Factory for ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI introduces the Performance Factory, a system that uses Codex-powered workflows to identify and resolve performance issues, ensuring ChatGPT remains fast and efficient.

items.title: Chorus: Shared N-gram Embeddings
items.summary: Researchers propose Chorus, a method for shared n-gram embeddings across layers, reducing memory usage while allowing layer-wise adaptation for better performance.

items.title: GUARD: Regret Guidance for RSI
items.summary: GUARD is a framework for stabilizing recursive self-improvement in AI agents by using regret guidance to avoid local regressions and skill forgetting.

items.title: BiMa-ECGSR: ECG Reconstruction
items.summary: BiMa-ECGSR uses bidirectional state-space models to reconstruct 12-lead ECGs from reduced lead sets, improving diagnostic accuracy in wearable devices.

items.title: Chebyshev Polynomial Zonotope Abstractions
items.summary: A new method for certified reachability in learning-enabled systems uses Chebyshev polynomial zonotope abstractions to handle nonlinear dynamics more effectively.

items.title: LUCID: Evaluating Latent Causal Structure Inference
items.summary: A new benchmark assesses whether models can infer market structures from financial data, crucial for understanding model behavior in complex systems.

items.title: FutureBench: Evaluating Knowledge-Context Conflict
items.summary: A renewable framework for assessing how models handle conflicting information, improving reliability in real-world applications.

items.title: SpecLook: Fast Agentic MLLMs
items.summary: A method to speculate where models should look for efficient and reliable reasoning, reducing latency in multi-step tasks.

items.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB RAM MoE Inference
items.summary: A breakthrough in large-scale model inference, pushing the limits of MoE with high parameter counts and memory efficiency for complex tasks.

items.title: Managing Frontier AI Risk
items.summary: OpenAI outlines its approach to managing risk from training to deployment, including model alignment, sandboxing, and monitoring. This provides a framework for safer AI development.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra Optimizes Chip Design
items.summary: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design.

items.title: DaisyRose-27B Advances Post-Training Efficiency
items.summary: DaisyRose-27B pushes the frontier of post-training efficiency, offering significant improvements in model performance and resource utilization.

items.summary: Google Gemini app now supports lower-memory Android devices, enabling access to Gemini Live and custom image creation on phones.

items.summary: CrisisBench is a privacy-preserving benchmark for evaluating single- and multi-turn crisis counseling AI, with 1,085 tasks from de-identified conversations.

items.summary: RAW measures user-side cost of refusal in deployed LLMs, using LLM stochasticity as a natural experiment to assess refusal behavior.
